_comment: Style presets. video_prompt is appended to every segment prompt; negative is added to the negative prompt. restyle_prompt (optional) redraws the keyframes in this style with FLUX.2 Klein before animating; leave it null for photos you want kept as they are. loras are optional Wan 2.2 I2V LoRAs you put in ComfyUI/models/loras (high/low noise pair, or the same file for both).

photoreal.label: Photorealistic
photoreal.video_prompt: photorealistic, natural lighting, realistic physics and motion, shot on a cinema camera, shallow depth of field
photoreal.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, drawing, 3d render, cgi

photoreal-from-art.label: Photorealistic (convert drawings)
photoreal-from-art.video_prompt: photorealistic, natural lighting, realistic physics and motion, shot on a cinema camera
photoreal-from-art.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, drawing, 3d render, cgi
photoreal-from-art.restyle_prompt: Turn this image into a realistic photograph with natural lighting and real-world materials. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing, characters and colors.

anime.label: Anime
anime.video_prompt: 2D anime style, cel shading, clean line art, vibrant flat colors, hand-drawn animation
anime.negative: photorealistic, photo, 3d render, realistic skin texture
anime.restyle_prompt: Redraw this image as a 2D anime illustration with cel shading, clean line art and vibrant flat colors. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

3d-cartoon.label: 3D cartoon
3d-cartoon.video_prompt: stylized 3D animated film look, soft global illumination, expressive cartoon characters, smooth subsurface skin
3d-cartoon.restyle_prompt: Re-render this image as a stylized 3D animated movie frame with soft lighting and expressive cartoon proportions. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

claymation.label: Claymation
claymation.video_prompt: claymation stop-motion, plasticine figures with fingerprints, handmade miniature set, slightly jerky stop-motion movement
claymation.restyle_prompt: Recreate this image as a claymation stop-motion scene made of plasticine with visible fingerprints on a handmade miniature set. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

watercolor.label: Watercolor
watercolor.video_prompt: animated watercolor painting, soft bleeding pigments, visible paper texture, gentle brush strokes
watercolor.negative: photorealistic, photo, 3d render, sharp digital lines
watercolor.restyle_prompt: Repaint this image as a soft watercolor painting with bleeding pigments and visible paper texture. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

comic.label: Comic / ink
comic.video_prompt: comic book style, bold black ink outlines, halftone shading, flat saturated colors
comic.restyle_prompt: Redraw this image as a comic book panel with bold black ink outlines, halftone shading and flat saturated colors. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

oil-painting.label: Oil painting
oil-painting.video_prompt: living oil painting, thick impasto brush strokes, rich colors, painterly texture in motion
oil-painting.restyle_prompt: Repaint this image as an oil painting with thick impasto brush strokes and rich colors. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.

pixel-art.label: Pixel art
pixel-art.video_prompt: retro 16-bit pixel art animation, limited color palette, crisp pixels
pixel-art.negative: photorealistic, photo, blurry, smooth gradients, 3d render
pixel-art.restyle_prompt: Redraw this image as retro 16-bit pixel art with a limited color palette and crisp pixels. Keep the exact composition, pose, framing and characters.
